senses.sense_definition: A person who fights with fists, especially a professional boxer.

examples.text: The veteran <w>pugilist</w> stepped into the ring determined to defend his championship title.
Before gloves became standard equipment, each bare-knuckle <w>pugilist</w> risked severe injury.

traits.comment: Often used in historical or formal contexts rather than modern sports reporting

senses.sense_definition: A person who aggressively defends a cause or engages in fierce verbal and rhetorical debates.

examples.text: The party needed a political <w>pugilist</w> who could dismantle the opponent's arguments during televised debates.
Known as a relentless <w>pugilist</w> for free speech, the editor never backed down from controversial topics.
